Thank you, Mr. Watson. I checked your car, and it has no open recalls. So the recall letter is not the same as the wrench light, and you don't need to send the number from the letter.

The 9:00 Tuesday slot in Scarborough is tomorrow, Tuesday, November 17. That is this week, not next week. I have not booked it yet. Do you want me to book tomorrow at 9:00 for the maintenance?
